purpose: A parallax plane for a website section: its content drifts at a slightly different rate from the scroll, so the page reads with quiet depth.
namedChanges: `useScrollFrame` is inlined as `src/useScrollFrame.ts`, the library `scroll-frame` unit's file, in place of the site's auto-imported `~/composables/useScrollFrame`; it behaves the same for `subscribe` and `reduced`, and has no `request()`, which this component never called.
The Tailwind class `pointer-events-none` on a decorative layer is the scoped class `pl-inert`.
Props are declared inline with `withDefaults` (same names and defaults); the source used runtime `defineProps({ … })`.
